subject: Cascade Tech — private deployment connectivity & implementation plan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cascade Tech — private deployment connectivity & initial coordination

Hi Oliver / Sarah,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your private deployment. I'm looping in Diego (deployment lead) and Priyom (network integrations) to start planning the connectivity and install sequence. Goal for this thread: align on VPC peering, private endpoint choices, and the on-prem package timeline so we can lock a two-week window for install and validation.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick networking review (30 min) to validate CIDR ranges, NAT/firewall constraints, and whether you prefer VPC peering or Private Endpoint + Transit.
- Decide on an install window for the on-prem package (we typically schedule 1 business day for install + 2 days for validation).
- Share VPC CIDRs, sample route tables, and any egress ACLs in advance.

Can you provide your preferred time slots this week? Also attaching our standard connectivity checklist (see attachment).

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the intro. Wed like to move quickly here. A few items from our side:

1) Attached are our VPC CIDR allocations and a basic diagram. Our infra team prefers peering where possible but wed like to discuss Private Endpoints for control plane traffic.
2) Are there any specific outbound ports Redwood needs that might be blocked by our current firewall rules?
3) We have an existing transit gateway in our us-west-2 account — can Redwood peer with transit attachments or do you prefer per-VPC peering?

Availability: Mon/Tue 11:00-14:00 PT works best for us. If we go with a Tuesday install, target dates would be Feb 23-25 for install + validation.

Attached:
- cascade_vpc_ranges.csv
- cascade_vpc_diagram.png

Thanks,

Internal — quick notes before we lock time with the customer:

- Priyom: please review the attached cascade_vpc_ranges.csv and confirm if any CIDR overlaps with our peering pool. If cascade wants to peer via the transit gateway, confirm whether we need a managed TGW attachment or if a simple VPC peering per-account is acceptable (TGW adds ~1 business day of prep).
- Rishi: check the firewall question — list of outbound ports needed: 443 outbound to our control plane, 5222 for telemetry (optional), and NTP. Also confirm whether mutual TLS will be required for the private endpoint (if so, we need cert exchange prior to install).
- Marissa: capture customer's preferred install dates (they offered Tue 11:00-14:00 PT windows). If we want Feb 23-25, let's confirm ASAP and reserve a slot with Infrastructure Ops.

I'll draft a short agenda for the 30-min networking review once Priyom confirms overlap/peering preference.

Diego

Subject: Re: Cascade Tech — private deployment connectivity & initial coordination

Hi Oliver / Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments.

We can run the 30-minute networking review on Tue, Feb 16 at 11:30 AM PT if that works for you. Proposed agenda:
- 5m introductions and scope
- 10m review of CIDRs, TGW vs per-VPC peering tradeoffs
- 10m private endpoint design (control plane vs data plane) and mutual TLS/cert exchange needs
- 5m install window & next steps (docs/links + DocuSign for MSP/PO if needed)

Pre-reads attached: Redwood connectivity checklist. Please also share route table screenshots (if you have them) and any enforced egress proxy details before the meeting.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Outbound ports: primary is 443 to our control plane and telemetry endpoints. If you enable telemetry over a private path, 5222 is optional.
- TGW: we support both approaches. If you can expose a TGW attachment, that reduces number of peering objects but requires a TGW attachment we can consume (TGW option may add 1 business day to prep).
- Mutual TLS: optional but recommended for control-plane requests to private endpoint; we can handle cert exchange over a secure link.

Confirm Tue 16 at 11:30 AM PT and well send a calendar invite with a Google Meet and attach the install checklist and DocuSign link for the order form.

Thanks,
Diego
Deployment Lead | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
